summary: PhD researcher in Earth and Atmospheric Sciences with experience in geospatial analysis, remote sensing, and data-driven approaches to weather and climate studies. My work focuses on exploring the application of machine learning and AI in improving weather forecasting and understanding climate variability. I have had the opportunity to work across diverse domains including atmospheric modeling, drought monitoring, air quality analysis, and satellite data interpretation. I have presented my work at conferences and contributed to peer-reviewed publications. I am continuously looking to learn, improve, and contribute to the growing intersection of geospatial science and AI for addressing real-world environmental challenges.
